title: Urgent
slide_intent: Teach writers to make time and action concrete. A reader needs to know what can be done, when it matters and who is affected.
strategic_value: Specific deadlines and achievable actions can connect global plans to the lives and experiences that give them urgency.
demonstration: The third principle defines an active tone, links urgency to human impact, then identifies the boundaries of accuracy and sincerity. The action column calls for time frames and a definite request.
practical_value: Replace an imprecise appeal with an achievable action and a time frame. Retain context needed to understand the facts.
